FN-PS4D9GR-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 50
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/13/2026
House Bill 50 as introduced would create the non-reverting Imagination Library of Alabama
Fund in the State Treasury to receive any funding to support the Imagination Library of Alabama
Program, established by this bill in statute. This bill would codify the existing practice,
implemented by Executive Order 729, requiring the program to be administered by the
Department of Early Childhood Education and operated by a non-profit entity. This bill would
require the department to contribute certain matching funds for participation in the Dolly Parton
Imagination Library, subject to annual appropriations from the Legislature.$2.85 million was
appropriated to the department from the Education Trust Fund and earmarked for the Dolly
Parton Imagination Library.

FN-PS4D9GR-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 50
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/30/2026
House Bill 50 as passed the House of Representatives would create the non-reverting
Imagination Library of Alabama Fund in the State Treasury to receive any funding to support the
Imagination Library of Alabama Program, established by this bill in statute. This bill would
codify the existing practice, implemented by Executive Order 729, requiring the program to be
administered by the Department of Early Childhood Education and operated by a non-profit
entity. This bill would require the department to contribute certain matching funds for
participation in the Dolly Parton Imagination Library, subject to annual appropriations from the
Legislature. For FY 2026 $2.85 million was appropriated to the department from the Education
Trust Fund and earmarked for the Dolly Parton Imagination Library.
